en: ...You. Of all the caves in Kanto, you had to walk into this one.
I came here to train where nobody would find me. I've been thinking about what it means to be strong.
Not winning at any cost. Something else. My Pokémon and I, together. I want to see if I've got it right.
I'm not angry. That's new. I'm going somewhere the dragons train. Don't follow me. Or do. I don't care.
